name: update-available
title: Update Available
description: New-deploy banner that polls a version endpoint (or takes a prop), explains what a refresh does, never refreshes while there are unsaved changes (offering "Refresh after I save"), and lets "Later" skip only that build.

meta.summary: Tells people a new version is out without losing work: it never refreshes over unsaved changes and offers "Refresh after I save".
catches: A newer build than the one running
Unsaved changes, which hold the refresh until saved
limits: Polling interval and endpoint are yours; nothing is pushed
Dirty state comes from your dirty prop
a11y: Banner is a region with an aria-label; message in a polite live region
Actions are labelled buttons; icons are aria-hidden
